cases: TC-1 · AC-1 after 14:00 on Friday skips the weekend and a listed Monday holiday, then counts 2 business days · bookedAt 2026-07-03T15:00, transitDays 2, holidays [2026-07-06] → shipDate 2026-07-07, deliveryDate 2026-07-09
TC-2 · AC-2 before cutoff on Wednesday the 1st, empty holiday list, transit 1 · bookedAt 2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays 1, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-01, deliveryDate 2026-07-02
TC-3 · AC-3 exactly 14:00 is not before the cutoff · bookedAt 2026-07-01T14:00, transitDays 1, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-02, deliveryDate 2026-07-03

TC-4 · one minute before the cutoff on a business day still ships that day · bookedAt 2026-07-01T13:59, transitDays 2, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-01, deliveryDate 2026-07-03 (Thu 07-02 = 1, Fri 07-03 = 2)

TC-5 · one minute after the cutoff ships the next business day and transit crosses the weekend · bookedAt 2026-07-01T14:01, transitDays 2, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-02, deliveryDate 2026-07-06 (Fri 07-03 = 1, Mon 07-06 = 2)
TC-6 · transitDays 0, the smallest allowed value, makes delivery equal the delayed ship day · bookedAt 2026-07-03T15:00, transitDays 0, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-06, deliveryDate 2026-07-06

TC-7 · Saturday and Sunday never ship; whole-number forms 1 and 1.0 mixed in one case · bookedAt 2026-07-04T09:00 transitDays 1 holidays [], and bookedAt 2026-07-05T13:59 transitDays 1.0 holidays [] → both shipDate 2026-07-06, deliveryDate 2026-07-07
TC-8 · a single holiday, and a booking on that holiday, ships the next business day · bookedAt 2026-07-06T10:00, transitDays 1, holidays [2026-07-06] → shipDate 2026-07-07, deliveryDate 2026-07-08

TC-9 · a holiday the rule must apply is honored in the first, middle and last list slots · bookedAt 2026-07-02T15:00, transitDays 2, holidays [2026-07-03, 2026-07-06, 2026-07-07] → shipDate 2026-07-08, deliveryDate 2026-07-10 (skip Fri, Mon and Tue; Thu 07-09 = 1, Fri 07-10 = 2)

TC-10 · leap day 2024-02-29 is a Thursday ship day and delivery crosses into March · bookedAt 2024-02-29T13:59, transitDays 2, holidays [] → shipDate 2024-02-29, deliveryDate 2024-03-04 (Fri 03-01 = 1, Mon 03-04 = 2)

TC-11 · last day of December ships, January 1 is a holiday, delivery falls in the next year · bookedAt 2026-12-31T10:00, transitDays 2, holidays [2027-01-01] → shipDate 2026-12-31, deliveryDate 2027-01-05 (skip Fri 01-01, Sat, Sun; Mon 01-04 = 1, Tue 01-05 = 2)

TC-12 · the holiday that falls inside the transit count is the middle list item, not the first or last · bookedAt 2026-07-13T09:00, transitDays 3, holidays [2026-01-01, 2026-07-15, 2026-12-25] → shipDate 2026-07-13, deliveryDate 2026-07-17 (Tue 07-14 = 1, skip Wed 07-15, Thu 07-16 = 2, Fri 07-17 = 3)

TC-13 · late Friday with no holidays ships Monday, not Tuesday · bookedAt 2026-07-03T15:00, transitDays 4, holidays [] → shipDate 2026-07-06, deliveryDate 2026-07-10 (Tue 07-07 = 1, Wed 07-08 = 2, Thu 07-09 = 3, Fri 07-10 = 4)
TC-14 · negative transitDays · bookedAt 2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays -1, holidays [] → throws Error invalid transitDays
TC-15 · transitDays that is not a whole number · bookedAt 2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays 2.5, holidays [] → throws Error invalid transitDays
TC-16 · an input field other than bookedAt, transitDays or holidays · bookedAt 2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays 1, holidays [], carrier road → throws Error unknown field: carrier
